scripts.build: npm run generate:check && npm run build -w @bjtu-mis/plugin-sdk && npm run build -w @bjtu-mis/plugin-cli && npm run build -w create-bjtu-plugin
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:check && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run template:check
scripts.template:check: npm run build -w @bjtu-mis/plugin-sdk && npm run template:check:built
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && npm run test:browser:built
scripts.pack:check: npm run build && npm run pack:check:built
scripts.check:ci: npm run build && npm run typecheck:built && npm run test:unit:built && npm run pack:check:built
